NONE: › formal (especially in business letters) about; on the subject of
（尤用於商務信函中）關於，茲就，事涉
› used in the subject line of an email when it is a reply to another email, followed by the subject of the original message
（用於回復電子郵件時的標題行，在被回復的郵件的標題之前）
› the second note of the sol-fa musical scale
來（大調音階的第二個音）
› used to add the meaning "do again", especially to verbs
（加在動詞前表示「再做」）重，又，再
› returning something to its original state

example: the regreening of our country (= making it green again by planting trees, allowing grass to grow, etc.)
